role: local nomination-action coverage of the original library at recoverable reference states
registration_context: recoverability labels observed; candidate-action suffix outcomes unobserved

roster.snapshot_selection: for every V3 April failed reference window, use current if its suffix is replayed feasible; otherwise use previous, which is replayed feasible

candidate_action.state: retain actual reference stocks and the two locked pending nominations at the selected snapshot
candidate_action.inputs: original available delivery forecast, original calibrated stress and received-only 90-minute BOA plan at that nomination time
candidate_action.profile: each of the same 64 original integer profiles; no new profiles, target levels, scoring, seed or parameter search
candidate_action.nomination: recompute only this new nomination using the frozen V3 control rule at the reference state

suffix_test.locked_commitments: fix the first three half-hours to the two original pending nominations plus the recomputed candidate nomination
suffix_test.continuation: all later half-hour nominations are free with full future BOA information, through the original window end
suffix_test.physical_model: unchanged original unit capacities, efficiencies, gross shared power and BOA priority
suffix_test.negative_control: also fix the reference's actual new nomination; it must be infeasible because the selected recoverability result and realized failure already imply this
suffix_test.replay: independently replay every distinct feasible witness, including all three locked nominations
suffix_test.reuse: within a single snapshot only, exactly identical signed nomination pairs may reuse their LP and replay result; report unique LP calls and reuse counts separately, without hashes

analysis: report the number and IDs of candidate actions permitting a feasible suffix at every snapshot; retain zero-coverage states and all negative controls; LP or replay failures remain unresolved
decision: zero-coverage snapshots identify gaps in this 64-candidate action set; complete local coverage instead directs attention to causal selection and cross-window policy coherence; neither result opens the full source-comparison gate
limitations: counterfactual actions at reference-policy states, not whole-window candidate rollouts; perfect-information continuations do not establish a shared causal policy, source benefit or independent confirmation
